neighbours.label: a non-initial subword piece of a multi-token proper name, mostly sports clubs and colleges (Osas|una, Grinn|ell, Wesley|an, Sunder|land)
fire: On Saturday Hartlepool held Bradford to a goalless draw at home.
The striker joined Leganés on loan for the rest of the season.
She earned a scholarship to Swarthmore and studied physics there.
Last weekend Huddersfield came from behind to beat Millwall.

quiet: On Saturday the home side held their rivals to a goalless draw.
The striker joined a new club on loan for the rest of the season.
She earned a scholarship to a small college and studied physics there.
Last weekend the visitors came from behind to win the match.
The coach left his old team after three seasons in the top flight.
He played basketball at a university before turning professional.
Fans in the north stand sang for the whole of the second half.
The rowing crew from the city won the race by two lengths.

notes: Card: tail pieces of club and college names (plus 'che|et|ah'). Probes 0.24-0.40 on Getafe, Wesleyan, Everton, cheetah; Grinnell only 0.06. Near misses use the same sports frames with common words.
